_readme: Live re-verification of every ClinicalTrials.gov record cited in research/manuscripts/program/emc-unexplored-treatment-lanes.md section 3.3 (FET-fusion trial eligibility), plus a widened registry screen for the same mechanism: eligibility that is fusion- or molecularly-defined in a way that admits EMC, behind a listed-condition set that no histology search for EMC would ever return. Every field here is read out of a payload retrieved on 2026-08-07 through a GitHub Actions runner - the dev sandbox egress proxy 403s clinicaltrials.gov on CONNECT (CLAUDE.md section 6). NOTHING here is carried from a review article or from memory.
_not_medical_advice: This file is a record of registry reads. It is not medical advice, it makes no claim that any listed treatment works in EMC, and eligibility for any trial is determined by that trial's team, not by this document.

retrieval.route: workflow_dispatch of .github/workflows/fetch-literature.yml on ref=main with targets_file set to an on-main URL manifest; the runner executes scripts/lit_fetch_urls.py and publishes to the literature-cache branch

transport_integrity.defect: scripts/lit_fetch_urls.py puts every payload through strip_html(), whose re.sub(r'(?s)<[^>]+>', ' ', raw) deletes the span from a '<' to the next '>'. ClinicalTrials.gov writes comparison operators as LITERAL angle brackets inside free-text criteria ('PLT < 100,000/mcL'), so each one opens a span that closes at the next '>' and eligibility criteria containing comparison operators lose text.
transport_integrity.⚠_superseded_retained: This field previously read 'ClinicalTrials.gov escapes angle brackets in free text as backslash-< and backslash->'. That account was tested and REFUTED: a synthetic written from it did not reproduce the defect, modules survived, and the damaged file's own footprint is 0 literal '<' and 13 orphaned literal '>'. The record that settles it is the comment block in scripts/lit_fetch_urls.py, which carries the same correction. Retained rather than deleted because a methods reader who implements a guard against ESCAPED brackets reproduces the bug.
two_failure_modes: LOUD: the deleted span crosses JSON structure and the record stops parsing. Detected per record; the NCT ids are listed under `unparseable_records`.

SILENT and more dangerous: the record still parses while whole modules have vanished. Detected by asserting that every unfielded record carries identificationModule, statusModule, conditionsModule, designModule and eligibilityModule; violations are listed under `silently_damaged_records`.
transport_integrity.rule_applied: No verbatim eligibility sentence is quoted in this file or in the draft notice unless that sentence itself carries no removal marker. Structured fields (status, dates, ages, condition lists) cannot be silently truncated in the same way and are treated as authoritative where the module survived.

task_1_reverification_of_section_3_3.result: All nine NCT numbers re-read live. No status differs from what section 3.3 records. One clarification and one staleness warning are noted per record.

confirmed_fusion_family_defined.assessment: The only trial in this sweep whose retrieved eligibility text names the FET fusion FAMILY rather than a specific partner gene. EMC's usual 5' partner EWSR1 is a FET protein. Its listed conditions contain no EMC term, so no histology search for EMC returns it. Eligibility is decided by the trial team.

No trial is indexed to EMC's driver gene.

_supporting_literature_read_in_the_same_.why: The draft notice states how often EMC's fusion partner is a FET-family gene. That figure was unsourced in the source memo, so the full text was retrieved rather than left as a remembered number.
_supporting_literature_read_in_the_same_.source: Stacchiotti S, Baldi GG, Morosi C, Gronchi A, Maestro R. Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma: State of the Art and Current Research on Biology and Clinical Management. Cancers (Basel) 2020;12(9):2703.
_supporting_literature_read_in_the_same_.verbatim: In the vast majority of cases (over 70%), NR4A3 fuses to the N-terminal transactivation domain of Ewing Sarcoma RNA Binding Protein 1 ( EWSR1 ) (chromosome 22q12.2) ... less frequently (about 20% of cases) to the transactivation domain of TATA-Box Binding Protein Associated Factor 15 (TAF15) ... Rarer (<5%) NR4A3 fusion partners include FUS (alias TLS ), TCF12 ... and Transforming Growth Factor ( TFG )
_supporting_literature_read_in_the_same_.provenance: SECONDARY - this is a review. Per systems/POLICY-evidence.md a review figure must not be presented as a primary study's; the primary series behind these percentages has NOT been traced.
_supporting_literature_read_in_the_same_.note_for_the_reader: EWSR1, TAF15 and FUS are the three FET-family genes; TCF12 and TFG are not.

limits_of_this_screen: The registry-wide EWSR1 term search returns full records and is therefore capped by response size, not by pageSize: 7 studies came back for pageSize=100. It is a sample of EWSR1-indexed trials, not an enumeration.
The large screens (fusion, basket, sarcoma) are fields-limited and carry no eligibility text, so they can identify candidates but cannot confirm one.
Four candidates therefore remain unconfirmed. Confirming them needs one further per-NCT registry read, which needs a new URL manifest on a ref CI can check out.
Non-US registries are not covered: the EU CTIS endpoint in the manifest returns 403 'Missing Authentication Token'.
